visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair holds a large yellow and white umbrella, speaking directly to a handheld camera at night. Behind him, a woman in a white t-shirt and dark skirt struggles to hold a brown umbrella against intense wind and heavy rainfall. The lighting is dominated by bright streetlights reflecting off the wet pavement. (2) The camera pans across a wide urban street intersection. The ground is wet and highly reflective under artificial streetlights and red traffic signals. A white sedan drives through the intersection, its headlights creating significant lens flares against the dark, rainy background. (3) Back to the characters, the woman is seen walking on a brick-paved sidewalk next to large colorful billboards with text and graphics. The wind is so strong it visibly pulls at her umbrella and clothing. The man's face returns to the frame, expressing mock-distress and humor. (4) A final sequence of shots shows the stormy streetscape again. Rain streaks are clearly visible against the dark sky and lit buildings. The man remains the primary focus, maintaining the selfie perspective as they navigate the extreme weather conditions on the sidewalk.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-intensity broadband noise from wind and heavy rain dominates the soundscape. A male voice, speaking Mandarin with high arousal and volume, shouts a narrative about his wife wanting to take a walk. Technical clipping occurs as wind hits the microphone. (2) As the camera pans, the acoustic texture shifts to include the low-frequency rumble of passing vehicle engines muffled by rain. A female voice contributes short bursts of laughter with a bright, high-aroused timbre. The umbrella fabric flaps violently, creating mid-frequency rustling. (3) The male speaker continues with high-pitched, strained vocal delivery. The sound of rain impacting various surfaces creates a dense, percussive bed. No background music is present; the audio is purely a field recording with low signal-to-noise ratio due to environmental masking.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously document and share a chaotic experience where a simple walk with a spouse turned into an encounter with extreme weather conditions.
